critical_code_review_comments: Task spec referenced [data-testid='topic-input'] and [data-testid='generate-btn'] but the actual testids on the page are [data-testid='scripts-topic'] and [data-testid='scripts-get-angles-btn']. Functionally correct, but worth either renaming the testids to match the iter_23 spec or updating the spec/docs so future agents are not misled. The CTA testid is also context-dependent (text becomes 'GENERATE 5-SHORT CONTENT SPRINT →' in sprint mode), so a stable name like 'scripts-primary-cta' might serve regression suites better.

Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_scripts.py line 75 still allows `4 <= len(angles) <= 5`. Since the iter_23 contract is firmly 5-and-only-5 (and the system prompt now mandates exactly 5 with one per category), tighten to `len(angles) == 5` and add an assertion that `{a['category'] for a in angles} == {'curiosity','contrarian','how-to','story','list'}` so any regression to 4 or to duplicate categories trips immediately.
(Carried from iter_14) Scripts.jsx is ~1283 lines — sprint flow, long-form flow, and angle-picker flow could each be their own hook for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iter_15 bugs are fully fixed and verified live. Key real testids on /scripts page: scripts-topic (textarea), scripts-get-angles-btn (primary CTA — its text changes by mode: 'SHOW ME 5 ANGLES →' in long-form/single, 'GENERATE 5-SHORT CONTENT SPRINT →' in shorts+sprint), scripts-mode-long, scripts-mode-shorts, sprint-opt-single, sprint-opt-sprint, sprint-grid, sprint-variant-1..5, angles-grid, angle-card-0..4, angle-card-N-pick, angle-card-N-save. The CSS vars --cat-curiosity / --cat-contrarian / --cat-howto / --cat-story / --cat-list are confirmed working — both the AngleCard inline-style var pass-through and the .sprint-variant[data-category=…] selectors resolve to the right rgb values. Auth: just POST {email} to /api/auth/check then write JWT to localStorage key 'f48_studio_token' — the dev login form submit handler sometimes doesn't fire on first click in Playwright; the localStorage shortcut is reliable.
rca of the issue: Original iter_23 RCAs: (a) ANGLES_SYSTEM_PROMPT used to instruct '4 distinct angles' so Claude returned 4; fixed by changing to 'surface 5 distinct creative ANGLES' + explicit 'Generate exactly 5 angles. Each must use a DIFFERENT category — one curiosity, one contrarian, one how-to, one story, one list.' Verified: live call returns exactly 5 with all 5 distinct categories. (b) Sprint variant cards all shared YouTube red because the App.css :root block didn't define --cat-curiosity / --cat-contrarian / --cat-howto / --cat-story / --cat-list, so AngleCard's inline `style={{ '--cat-color': cat.color }}` resolved cat.color (var(--cat-curiosity)) to an undefined var and fell back to the default red. Fix added the 5 :root vars + new .sprint-variant[data-category=…] CSS rules that set --variant-accent and apply it to border, background tint, .sprint-variant-cat color/bg, and .sprint-variant-promote button. SprintResult.jsx now also writes data-category=lowercased-cat onto each card. All three layers (CSS vars, data-category attr, CSS attribute selector) verified working end-to-end via window.getComputedStyle.
